lines.zh: 我沿着沼泽边的草滑过去。
lines.en: I glide along the grass at the marsh's edge.

lines.zh: 身子贴着地，追着太阳走。
lines.en: Belly to the ground, I follow the sun.

lines.zh: 我的花纹像玉米粒一样排着。
lines.en: My pattern runs in rows like corn kernels.

lines.zh: 我从一丛芦苇里穿过去。
lines.en: I slip through a stand of reeds.

lines.zh: 我爬得很慢，可路线很直。
lines.en: I move slowly, but my line is straight.

lines.zh: 我绕开长满青苔的石块
lines.en: I skirt the moss-covered stone.

lines.zh: 我往有光的地方多爬一会。
lines.en: I linger a while where the light is.

lines.zh: 我钻进两根树根的缝里
lines.en: I squeeze into the gap between two roots.

lines.zh: 我沿着一条干的地带走。
lines.en: I take a strip of dry ground.

lines.zh: 我把身子一节节推向前
lines.en: I push my body forward section by section.
I climb out of the water onto dry ground.
I poke my head out of the grass.
I coil at the foot of the reeds.
I flick my tongue, reading the air.

lines.zh: 太阳透过叶子落在我身上。
lines.en: Sun comes through the leaves onto me.
Still, I look like a thin twig.
My head is slightly raised.
I smell water and mud.

lines.zh: 我把自己绕成一个更小的圈
lines.en: I wind myself into a smaller loop.
Frogs are calling; I listen.

lines.zh: 我的花纹在阴影里变暗。
lines.en: My pattern darkens in the shade.
My tongue forks and flicks.

lines.zh: 我慢慢把头转向另一边。
lines.en: I turn my head slowly the other way.
A bug has landed on the water.
I coil myself smaller.
I'm quiet and patient.

lines.zh: 我身上有一层薄薄的水。
lines.en: A thin film of water sits on me.
I can't blink at all.

lines.zh: 阴影挪了，我又晒到太阳。
lines.en: The shade moved and I'm in the sun again.
My tail tip rests on a leaf.
You're in the water; I'm on the bank.

lines.zh: 我从叶堆里把脖子撑起来
lines.en: I lift my neck out of the leaf litter.
You're stepping on the reeds.

lines.zh: 我的花纹在阳光下很清楚。
lines.en: My pattern shows clearly in the sun.
I don't intend to move.

lines.zh: 你每一步都震到我的肚皮
lines.en: Every step of yours shakes my belly.

lines.zh: 我把身体往后缩了半寸。
lines.en: I've drawn back half an inch.

lines.zh: 汗味、铁味、还有别的味道
lines.en: Sweat, iron, and something else on you.

lines.zh: 我吐了吐舌头，又收回去。
lines.en: I flick my tongue and pull it back.
We're at a standoff like this.
Only when you retreat do I move.
I slide slowly behind a leaf.
I bolt into the grass.

lines.zh: 我一路滑到芦苇深处才停
lines.en: I slide deep into the reeds before I stop.
That landed mid-body.
I've coiled up tight.
Water runs off my scales.

lines.zh: 我的头藏在最深的地方。
lines.en: My head is tucked away deepest.
I didn't make the slightest sound.
It's a long while before I move.

lines.zh: 我的鳞被蹭掉一片，我抽了一下
lines.en: A scale scraped off and my body jerks.
The smell in the mud is noted.
I smell a bug.
I reach my head toward the smell.
Not too big, not too small. One bite.
Hold it lower. I can't reach that high.
First I see whether it moves.
I catch it in one strike.

lines.zh: 它顺着我的喉咙滑下去
lines.en: It slides down my throat.
This smell is common by the water.
I coil on the stone and wait.
That was a good meal.

lines.zh: 你的鞋跟压住我的尾尖
lines.en: Your heel pins the tip of my tail.
I darted away.
I'm hiding under the reeds.
Now I'm wet.
I slowly poke my head out again.

lines.zh: 你挡在我要走的路上了。
lines.en: You're standing in my path.

lines.zh: 我从你两脚之间穿过去
lines.en: I slip between your two feet.
My body has been bent aside.
We touched; we're both cold.

lines.zh: 我滑回水里，只留眼睛在外
lines.en: I slip back into the water with only my eyes above it.
Another comes out of the reeds.
Its pattern is different from mine.
Side by side we look well.
Its colour is redder.
That gets bred out over time.
I touch it with my head.
We glide onto the stone together.
The sun's right and neither of us moves.
Then it went into the water.

lines.zh: 我盘在岸边的暖石上等它
lines.en: I coil on the warm bank stone and wait for it.
I take the whole bug up.

lines.zh: 我让它整只滑进喉咙里
lines.en: I let the whole thing slide into my throat.
It's still moving in my mouth.
I spat it out; not food.
I pin it under my head.
I butt it with my snout.
It rolled into the water.
I drag it by the teeth onto dry ground.
I sniff and go around it.
I coil over it.
Something's moving in the reeds.
I press my head down to the mud.
I swing my head that way.
It's still pawing at the dirt.
My body is gathered.
I've lined it up with my mouth.
I test the hinge of my jaw first.
Within two feet, I can reach it.

lines.zh: 它背对我的一瞬就是机会
lines.en: The instant its back turns is my chance.
This is the opening.
I trail it along the waterline, stretch by stretch.
It goes left; I take the grass.
The grass doesn't even bend where I pass.
It has suddenly lowered its head.
I stretch my body into a line.

lines.zh: 芦苇叶挡着我，我又挪一寸
lines.en: The reeds hide me as I creep an inch closer.
It stops, and I hold.

lines.zh: 我的花纹让它看不清我。
lines.en: My pattern hides me.
It's right there.
My coils are set to strike.
My teeth catch it first.
I coil around its leg.

lines.zh: 我每绕一圈就多使点力
lines.en: Each loop I add, I squeeze a little harder.

lines.zh: 它的腿在我身下蹬了蹬
lines.en: Its legs kick beneath my coils.
I start swallowing it segment by segment.
My jaw is stretched wide.
I work it into my throat.
I coil up to digest.
This will feed me for days.
It tasted a little bitter.
I slip out from the roots of the reeds.
The first sight is water and green.
I'm already wet.
The sun on the water is bright.
My pattern is the common one.
I unspool my body bit by bit.

lines.zh: 草很高，我探出头看四周
lines.en: The grass is tall, so I raise my head and look around.
Frogs are calling nearby.
I head for that stone.
I test the depth of the water.

lines.zh: 我的鳞在光里排得很齐。
lines.en: My scales line up neatly in the light.
I coil once and loosen.

lines.zh: 火一靠近，我立刻松开了。
lines.en: Fire comes near and I come uncoiled.

lines.zh: 我从石头上滑下去，摔得摊开。
lines.en: I slip off the stone and land spread out.

lines.zh: 水灌进我嘴里，我挣不动。
lines.en: Water floods my mouth and I can't struggle.
The blast throws me into the reeds.
An arrowhead lodges mid-body.
A force cinches my coils.

lines.zh: 饿得连吐信子的力气都没
lines.en: I'm too hungry to even flick my tongue.

lines.zh: 雷落下来，我整条都僵了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and my whole length stiffens.
The water's gone and I fall.
